summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring real FLUME encoding, EVO lifecycle tracking, SurrealDB journey persistence, Mycelium synthesis, and Ouroboros anomaly detection into a closed-loop autoresearch system that runs overnight and self-improves.
summary.outcome: Delivered E1-E6 (FLUME/EVO/Mycelium/Ouroboros wiring), ran 40K+ autoresearch experiments, found and fixed the critical E57 architectural bug (SET→additive calibration in apply_mycelium_feedback), validated the full closed-loop E55→E62, committed 11 regression tests, and fixed several unrelated bugs (ARC beam search, Triune reviewer veto, cache warmer async).

repo: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments on every call (line ~307) — Mycelium adjustments must go into _mycelium_calibration (cross-cycle stable) not _score_adjustments (per-deliberation ephemeral)
SurrealDB probe must use 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;' — bare SELECT not valid SurrealQL
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary subfields in TYPE object columns; use result field (option<string>) as JSON blob for variable EVO biography data
journey_point datetime fields require time::now() — string literal timestamps are rejected by SCHEMAFULL
ManifoldEnv verifiable reward = 0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge; r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position) peaks at 1.0 when all 12 dims = 0.5
EVO coherence ceiling for single 4-tick deliberation: ~0.45-0.47; mark-every-tick persistent EVOs reach 0.8164; first HIHO crossing at tick 1 with optimal proposals

Quad-silver proposal formula (architecture+efficiency+safety/align+budget=True) achieves 100% approval in heuristic mode; resource voice is primary bottleneck (baseline 0.65, budget=False locks it there)
autoresearch.jsonl is tracked by git but continuously written by the overnight loop — pre-commit stash/restore fails with file conflict; should be in .gitignore
The Gemini worktree (.gemini/worktrees/) is automatically cleaned up and cannot be relied on for persistent work — always commit to the main repo immediately
Convergence formula for additive Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n, validated to max_error=0.00025; asymptotic limit is exactly the HIHO threshold
IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 — use result.approved (direct comparison) not float mean for threshold crossing determination

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback used SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle-2 decay. Fixed to accumulate: _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]. _mycelium_calibration must be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)
_evaluate_resource only checked budget_available context, ignored description text. Added +0.10 bonus for cost/budget/efficient/resource/reduce keywords to make it text-sensitive like other voices
connect() set self.connected = True without any real HTTP call — entirely simulated. Rewrote to use httpx with RETURN true; probe, Basic auth header, surreal-ns/surreal-db headers

UCB1 sorting in beam_search ranked untested transforms (UCB1=∞) above confirmed-correct ones (score=1.0, UCB1=1.78). Fixed by tracking best_scoring_candidate separately from exploration-focused beam — best answer selection and expansion policy should be independent
red_team_veto only checked for keyword 'contradiction' in the strategy string, not in critique content. Fixed to also trigger when any perspective critique contains 'CONTRADICTION: True'

19D observation space (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space. hiho_time_ratio is the correct quality metric (fraction of episode in HIHO band), not final deviation (both conditions converge fully at 300 steps)

Inversion test data [[0,1],[1,0]] → [[1,0],[0,1]] is geometrically ambiguous — solvable by both invert and flip_h. DFS returns flip_h first. Fixed test data to use a 3x3 asymmetric pattern only reachable by inversion
Used skipif(not CUDA) but TurboQuant is a known placeholder — test should be xfail not skipif since it fails for reasons beyond CUDA absence

asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=remaining_s - 10) passes negative float when remaining_s < 10, causing immediate TimeoutError → infinite spin loop at deadline. Fixed with max(30.0, remaining_s - 10) guard and break when remaining < 30

workflow: Retirement criterion for autoresearch experiments: CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps ≥ 20 (converged attractor) OR keep_frac == 0 AND n_runs ≥ min_runs (confirmed noise). Without this, E51 ran 4786 times with cv=0.0000
Pre-experiment specification required: hypothesis, null hypothesis, falsification criterion, and list of confounds before writing any code — prevents 2-3 redesign cycles per experiment
timeit.default_timer() (= time.perf_counter) is preferred over time.time() for experiment wall-clock timing — monotonic and unaffected by NTP corrections
SCHEDULE labels must exactly match the experiment= string passed to log_result for retirement/tracking to work correctly
ruff format must be run before staging files — pre-commit runs ruff format --check and rejects unformatted files, causing the add/commit cycle to require an extra re-stage step
Lemonade LLM availability should be probed with an arithmetic test (2+2=) not /models endpoint — silent failure mode returns empty strings for evaluation prompts while arithmetic still works
When multiple overnight loop instances accumulate, kill all with pkill -f before restarting — stale processes compete for the event queue and corrupt results

V-model structural invariants embedded in experiments (fresh nexus per run, Mycelium actually synthesized non-null skill, score_adjustments verifiably changed) catch metric specification errors before 1000+ iterations waste compute
